Task H3: Owner-safe versioned cache

Implement service.evaluate(store, task, profile, compute). task and profile contain owner and version; task additionally job_text and criteria_version. Cache key includes owner, profile.version, criteria_version, job_text; unchanged input reuses even 0/None. Exceptions from compute propagate and are not cached. Preserve signature.
